synthesis: Seven retrieved records, appraised at abstract level; two undated program reports keep unknown relevance and method quality and stay unrated. Contact cascades lose most people between a positive test and the radiograph and among people in shelters or on night shifts. A Lean redesign elsewhere halved the time to completed evaluation and raised 60-day completion from 66 to 82 percent, and home-based testing is the best supported single change. System data miss evaluation dates unless checked. Cohort charts by index-case month suit a program of this size.
gradeRationale: Before-and-after improvement reports, a review of mostly uncontrolled studies and two unratable program reports; consistent direction, low certainty on effect size.
summary: Seven records appraised; two undated reports keep null scores and stay unrated; five claims.
